evidence.title: GitHub - shadcn-ui/ui: Composable, accessible components with thoughtful defaults. · GitHub

name: shadcn
summary: Agent skill for a project-aware shadcn/ui workflow: finding, adding, composing and fixing components correctly.
description: A SKILL.md package that gives coding agents a project-aware shadcn/ui workflow. It reads the injected project context — import aliases, RSC, Tailwind version, base primitives, icon library, style — then uses it to search, add, compose and fix components instead of guessing, with a component-selection table, styling rules for Tailwind utilities and semantic tokens, CLI commands (info, search, docs, add, view) and safe-update guidance. Secondary references cover styling, forms, composition, icons and chat. Installs with the skills CLI from the shadcn-ui/ui repo (MIT).
contains: installs with npx skills add from the shadcn-ui/ui repo (MIT)
project context: aliases, isRSC, tailwindVersion, style, base, iconLibrary, framework
component selection table from needs to shadcn components
workflow with the shadcn CLI: info, search, docs, view, add --diff
styling rules: gap-*, size-*, badge variants and semantic tokens over raw colors
reference files: styling.md, forms.md, composition.md, icons.md, chat.md
